title: Git
loadError: Could not read this folder's changes. Make sure the folder is still there, then try again.
notInitialized: This folder is not a Git repository yet
notInitializedHint: This folder is already open as a map. Make it a Git repository and every edit can be committed, read back and restored.
neverSent: This branch was never pushed to origin
sendBranchHint: Pushes {branch} to origin for the first time. From then on, Push and Pull follow origin/{branch}. Only when you press it.
detachedHead: A commit is checked out, not a branch. Pushing needs a branch.
upstreamUnknown: No upstream set for this branch
pushOptInHint: Pushes to {upstream}: only when you press it.
pushNoUpstream: Commits stay on this computer for now. Add a remote repository address to push.
pushOptInFirstHint: Pushes to origin: {branch} goes there for the first time and tracks it from then on. Only when you press it.
pushDetachedHint: A commit is checked out, not a branch, so nothing can be pushed.
pushFailed: Couldn't reach {remote}. Your {count} commit(s) are still on this computer.
stagedOutsideNotice: {count} change(s) staged outside this folder are left alone.
diffEmpty: This is a new document, so there's nothing earlier to compare.
diffTooLarge: This change is too large to show line by line.
webNoChanges: Nothing yet. Edit a document and it shows up here.
webDesktopHint: A browser isn't allowed to run git on this computer. What changed is still shown here.
scopeNotice: New commits record changes in this folder only.
pullScopeNotice: Pull may change files anywhere in this repository.
initWhatHappens: This adds one .git folder inside this folder. Your documents stay as they are, and commits live only on this computer.
initEscape: To undo this, delete the .git folder that was just created. Your documents stay.
noChangesHint: This folder matches your last commit. Edit a document and it shows up here.
remoteSetupBody: To read this on another machine or keep a backup, tell us the remote repository (GitHub, GitLab, …) once. We only push to that address, and only when you click.
remoteHelp: You can copy the URL from the Code button on the GitHub/GitLab repository page.
remoteFailedSafe: Your commits are still on this computer.
historyEmptyHint: Edit a document, then make your first commit on the left.

install.title: git isn't on this computer
install.body: git is the program that keeps your change history. Install it once and everything else happens on this screen.
install.xcode: Install command line tools (recommended: Apple's built-in path)
install.winget: Install with winget (recommended: built into Windows)

noVaultTitle: Pick the folder to track with Git
noVaultBody: Choose a folder in Documents and you can commit its changes right here.
diffSkippedHint: There are unchanged lines in between
stepSelectHint: Press to see this commit's exact values
webCopyFailed: Copy failed: the clipboard was blocked
cliPlaceholderHint: Set this once in your terminal: export ATLAS="path to your ontology-atlas source folder". There is no npm package.
remoteFetchHint: Get the remote's latest state. Files in this folder are not touched.
remotePullHint: {behind} behind the last checked remote state. Pull may change files anywhere in this repository.
remotePullUnknownHint: Use Fetch to check the remote. Pull may change files anywhere in this repository.
remotePushUnknownHint: The number of commits to push is unknown. Use Fetch to check again.
remotePushNoneHint: No commits to push relative to the last checked remote.
remotePushCommitsFirstHint: {count, plural, one {# change is} other {# changes are}} not committed yet. Pressing opens the commit step first; nothing is pushed until you confirm.
remoteDoneFirstSend: Pushed {branch} to origin. Push and Pull now follow origin/{branch}.
remoteStale: As of the last check. Use Fetch to refresh.
egoHint: Point at a neighbour to light it in the drawing · click to move there
egoEmpty: This concept has no links yet
dockNoRemote: Still only on this machine: connect a remote repository to read it elsewhere and keep a backup.
dockNeverSent: origin is connected, but this branch has never been pushed there. Push it to read it elsewhere and keep a backup.
dockDetached: Commit {commit} has no branch to push from. Switch to a branch in the terminal (git switch) to push.
remoteOnlyTitle: {count} commit(s) only on the last checked remote
remoteOnlyHint: Pull from the remote · files anywhere in the repository may change.
pendingHint: {count} file(s) · commit to add to the history
summaryNoUpstream: no remote to push to yet
discardConfirmBody: The uncommitted {added} added and {removed} removed lines in this document go away. They were never committed, so git does not hold them either: this cannot be undone.
discardConfirmDeleted: This deleted document comes back as it was in the last commit.
discardConfirmOthers: Other documents stay as they are. {count} uncommitted change(s) remain.
discardDone: Discarded the changes in {path}. It matches the last commit again.
restoreConfirmBody: Replaces the current content of {path} with its content at this commit ({when}).
restoreConfirmPending: This document has uncommitted changes ({added} added, {removed} removed lines), and those go away too.
restoreConfirmLands: The result stays as an uncommitted change. Read it line by line, and discard it if you change your mind.
restoreConfirmOthers: The other {count} document(s) this commit changed stay as they are.
restoreDone: Restored {path} to this commit's content. It is an uncommitted change now.
restoreDoneOthers: The other {count} document(s) this commit changed stay as they are.
restoreAbsentDeleted: This commit deleted the document, so the content to restore is in the commits below
docHistoryTitle: Other commits that changed this document
docHistoryOnly: This is the only commit that changed this document
docNotInStep: {path} is not among the files this commit lists, so no document is selected here.
docHistoryOlder: Older commits exist too. Show older commits in the list on the left to reach them
docHistoryJumpHint: Press to jump to that commit
docReaderPartial: The whole document could not be read; only the changed part is shown
docReaderLong: The document is long, so only the changed part is shown
